idea-plugin.name: E-Invoice Mandate Lint - EU 2026
idea-plugin.description:
Lints UBL and CII invoice XML against EN 16931 and the national e-invoicing mandates that are live in 2026

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → E-Invoice Mandate Lint - EU 2026: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. Offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/einvoice-mandate-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/einvoice-mandate-lint

action.text: E-Invoice Mandate Lint - EU 2026: Check This File
action.description: Run E-Invoice Mandate Lint - EU 2026 on the file in the editor
